info.name: Splitwise MVP API
info.description:
Full API test collection for the Splitwise MVP.

**How to run**
1. Start the server: `npm run dev` (listens on `SERVER_PORT`, default 3000).
2. Import this collection into Postman.
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, top to bottom - requests chain via collection variables (`userAId`, `userBId`, `userCId`, `expenseId`).

Every request has assertions. The suite is self-seeding: the Setup folder creates three users with randomized emails, so it can be re-run repeatedly without conflicts. The Cleanup folder deletes them again.

All endpoints are also available without the `/api` prefix; this collection uses `/api`.
